01

Stephanie Goetz

Former TV news anchor · Keynote speaker & executive coach · LinkedIn

Strategy Ghostwriting Outreach 6 months
636,877 impressions in 6 months
+228% impressions in the last 31 days
+15% follower growth
30+ inbound speaking & podcast invites

The problem: Her reputation as a speaker was growing offline, but nothing showed up on LinkedIn. Posting was inconsistent and her story wasn't turning into inbound interest for keynotes or coaching.

What I did: I took over her entire LinkedIn presence — writing every post in her voice, building content pillars from her real experiences, and running 100–150 targeted outreach connections per week to founders and leaders aged 30–45.

The result: 636,877 impressions, 30+ inbound speaking invites, and a consistent pipeline of high-ticket leads — all from organic LinkedIn.

Who is behind the strategy?

I'm Samrah. I think in strategy and create in stories.

I'm a social media manager and creative strategist. I work with founders, coaches, creators and luxury brands, mostly on LinkedIn and Instagram.

My work sits between thinking and making. I figure out who you need to reach, what they need to hear and where the content opportunities are. Then I write and shape the content that says it, and turn your business goals into a plan you can actually follow.

Before I write a word, I learn how you think and speak, so what goes out sounds like you and no one else. AI helps me move faster. I never let it write the feeling — that's the part people trust.
